the fence is a mechanic and not a second shopfront: a licensed counter refuses a customs-sealed line naming the docket it would file, and downbelow takes it at 37.5% of shelf

the till equals the sum of its own signed rows, and no counter anywhere pays more than it charges (0 pairs over 18 counters)

findings.text: THERE IS NO KEYPRESS. The verb is complete in Python and the engine has no SELL branch: `_verb_serve` buys only, and `interact.counter_offer` bakes {sells, goods, tier} with no `buys`/`bid` half. Both files are outside this agent's ownership. Until that lands a player cannot perform the verb, only the world can.

Coverage is computed by building every vendor's goods_list once and memoising. Measured only as part of --trade's wall clock; there is no marginal-rate measurement of it and no budget it is scored against.
A sale is a number in a ledger. No sound, no animation, no counter-side reaction, and the keeper is a name in a constant rather than anybody a player meets.
